jump.title: Jump to this lesson?
jump.body: This will unlock every lesson up to this point without marking the skipped lessons as completed.

planned.body: This lesson is already part of the complete learning path. Its interactive exercises will be added on top of this same structure as the course grows.

firstContact.title: Learn to play
firstContact.description: Movement, captures, check and the rules you need to understand a game from zero.

beginner.title: Beginner
beginner.description: Start playing complete games safely: material, special rules, development and king safety.

intermediate.title: Intermediate
intermediate.description: Recognise tactical patterns, threats and the first strategic plans that improve your positions.

ready.title: Ready player
ready.description: Essential endgames, calculation habits and practical checks before you move.
